background_setting: A busy urban intersection viewed from the driver's seat of a stopped car. Multi-story commercial buildings with glass and concrete facades line the cross streets. Traffic lights hang overhead, storefronts and street signage are visible along the sidewalks, and painted crosswalk lines mark the pavement. The scene is under a flat, overcast sky that mutes colors and softens all shadows. Wet-looking gray asphalt reflects dim ambient light. A green traffic signal glows for the ego vehicle's lane.

lighting.direction: Diffuse top-down ambient light from a cloudy sky
lighting.shadows: Soft, faint shadows beneath vehicles with little contrast
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, low-contrast illumination that flattens the scene and makes the vehicle headlights and glowing traffic signals stand out

aesthetics.composition: Symmetrical dashcam framing centered on the intersection with the crossing procession filling the mid-ground, traffic signals visible at top
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted grays and desaturated urban tones punctuated by black vehicles, warm white headlight glow, purple flags, and a green traffic signal
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating line of headlight pairs and purple flags along the procession

cinematography.camera_motion: Static then forward dolly as the ego vehicle accelerates into the gap; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the crossing procession and intersection ahead

context: Autonomous driving scenario illustrating an ego vehicle failing to recognize a funeral procession as a single continuous group and driving into a gap

actions.description: Ego car sits stopped at the green light as the black hearse enters the intersection from the left. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The line of following cars with headlights and purple flags crosses slowly in front of the ego vehicle as one unbroken group. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

A gap opens between two procession cars; the ego vehicle accelerates forward into the gap without stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: White text on black rectangular street sign, small
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Upper left background near the cross street, visible throughout

segments.description: The ego vehicle is stopped at the green light while the hearse and following cars of the funeral procession cross slowly in front, moving as a single unbroken group with headlights on and purple flags on their hoods. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Procession advances across the intersection; a gap begins to form between two cars
segments.camera: Static ego view holding on the intersection; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

segments.description: Treating each car independently, the ego vehicle accelerates forward into the gap between two procession cars without stopping, cutting through the funeral line. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Ego vehicle transitions from stationary to forward motion, entering the intersection
segments.camera: Forward dolly following the ego vehicle's acceleration; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car is stopped at a green light at an overcast city intersection, and the black hearse rolls in from the left with its headlights on and a purple flag on the hood. From 0:01 to 0:03 the following cars of the funeral procession stream across in front, all with headlights lit and small purple flags, moving as one continuous unbroken group. Around 0:03 a gap opens between two of the procession cars, and from 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle, treating each car as an independent obstacle, accelerates forward into that gap and drives through the funeral line without stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient urban soundscape with distant traffic hum, faint idling engines of the procession vehicles, and the soft whoosh of tires on damp pavement. As the ego vehicle accelerates, its engine note rises. No music or speech.
